heros.infro: Often overlooked in favour of his predecessor Alfred the Great the fifteen years of the reign of Aethelstan, dubbed 'The Glorious', were pivotal in the development of English political power.  During the first year of his reign he wrested Northumbria from its Viking overlords, which meant that for the first time in its history all of England was united under a single monarch.  The rest of his reign was spent subduing Scotland and Wales establishing their rulers as "Subreguli" indicating their subservience to the English King.  Although this was a relatively shortlived arrangement Aethelstan is considered the first true "King of all Britain".
heros.name: Aethelstan

heros.infro: Italian explorer, navigator and cartographer. He participated in several voyages that explored the coast of South America.
heros.name: Amerigo Vespucci

heros.infro: Eldest son of Louis the Pious, while in power as the Holy Roman Emperor he claimed the land his father had divided up between several parties prior to his death as his own.  His bold move was met with swift resistance and he was defeated easily by his brother Louis the German.  Although he failed, he retained some power after the peace negotiations.
heros.name: Lothair I

player.headline: I take it up the clacker
